fields.Name: T299 - Integrations Activity Filter Popover
fields.Description: Exercises the Activity mj-filter-popover + mj-filter-panel wired to ActivityFilterFields/OnFilterValuesChange narrowing the run list — a surface-specific filter feature distinct from the generic grid status filter.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Activity' section. In the toolbar, click the Filters button to open the filter popover and verify a filter panel renders with fields (e.g. status / date / integration). Choose a status filter value and apply it, then confirm the run list responds — rows narrow to matching runs OR a clear 'No runs found for the selected filters' message appears. Also confirm an active-filter count/badge or a Clear-All control appears once a filter is set. Seeing the filter UI render and the list respond is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Filters popover opens showing a filter panel with selectable fields
Applying a status filter narrows the run list OR shows a clear no-match message
An active-filter indicator or Clear-All control appears when a filter is active
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
